blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers thinks House panel members Rep. Terry Ridon and lawyer Benjamin Tolosa Jr. were only trying to explain the proceedings of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial — not influence the senator-judges. “Perhaps there were some expressions in the desire to make the issue understandable and relatable to the Filipino people. But someone must have gone over,” Barbers explained in an online news conference on Friday. Barbers had been asked about the responses of Ridon and Tolosa to the show-cause orders issued by the Senate court concerning their public statements on the impeachment trial that […]...
